It's probably a race condition: there are two threads in joblib, one to
dispatch the computation, and the other to retrieve the results. There is
a lock. I believe that their might be a race condition that could create
a deadlock. We would really need more eyes on this code...
[Here is a log](https://gist.github.com/anonymous/5034193). Hth.

@bobhancock Which BLAS do you have, OpenBLAS or ATLAS? Not sure if those are called in the failing test, but I've noticed OpenBLAS can cause tests to hang.

```
dpkg -l '*blas*'
```
Does OpenBLAS have problems with joblib?
